sentenceSets.sentence: There was no appreciable difference between the two formulas—both performed identically in trials.

answerChoices.reasoning: Both can be detected, but measurable means capable of being measured, while appreciable means perceptible and noticeable to observation.
Both can be detected, but appreciable and perceptible are near-synonyms; 'appreciable' stresses being noticeable and significant enough to value.
Both imply importance, but significant means meaningful, while appreciable means perceptible and noticeable.
Both can be seen or detected, but visible is literal sight, while appreciable means noticeable to observation.
Distinct means clearly different, but appreciable means only noticeable or perceptible, not necessarily strikingly different.
Apparent means seeming or evident, but appreciable means actually perceptible and detectable, not just seeming.
Obvious means very clear and easy to see, while appreciable means merely noticeable or perceptible.
Substantial means considerable in amount, but appreciable means simply detectable or perceptible.
Negligible means so small as to be unimportant; the sentence states there was no appreciable difference, confirming it was unnoticeable.
Identical means exactly the same; the sentence uses 'no appreciable difference' to mean they were functionally identical in performance.
Pronounced means very marked or noticeable; the sentence indicates there was no appreciable difference, so nothing was pronounced.

sentenceSets.sentence: The professor noted an appreciable improvement in the student's essays over the semester, moving from struggling to competent work.

answerChoices.reasoning: Both describe noticeable change, but dramatic means strikingly intense, while appreciable means noticeably perceptible improvement.
Both describe clear change, but marked means prominently noticeable, while appreciable means perceptibly improved but perhaps less prominently.
Both are readily apparent, but obvious means very clear and easy to see, while appreciable means noticeable but perhaps more subtle.
Both imply importance, but significant means meaningful, while appreciable means perceptibly improved.
Substantial means considerable, but appreciable means simply noticeable, which may not be substantial.
Considerable means notably large, but appreciable means merely perceptible, possibly smaller.
Noteworthy means worth noting, but appreciable specifically means perceptibly improved.
Discernible means able to be seen or identified, but appreciable emphasizes the noticeable perceptibility more strongly.
Stagnant means showing no improvement; the sentence describes an appreciable improvement from struggling to competent.
Imperceptible means not noticeable; the sentence describes appreciable improvement the professor clearly observed.
Regressive means moving backward; the sentence describes improvement moving forward from struggling to competent.

sentenceSets.sentence: After the medication, there was an appreciable reduction in symptoms within hours, though not a complete cure.

answerChoices.reasoning: Both describe extent, but total means complete and entire, while appreciable means noticeable but partial.
Both describe extent, but complete means full and total, while appreciable means perceptibly improved but not complete.
Both describe effectiveness, but decisive means conclusive, while appreciable means noticeably improved but not conclusively resolved.
Both describe impact magnitude, but overwhelming means powerful and all-encompassing, while appreciable means noticeable but partial.
Instant means immediate, but appreciable refers to the magnitude of reduction, not the speed of onset.
Rapid means quick, but appreciable refers to the noticeable extent of symptom reduction, not how quickly it happened.
Remarkable means worthy of notice, but appreciable specifically means perceptibly noticeable.
Beneficial means helpful, but appreciable specifically means noticeably perceptible in magnitude.
Minimal means very small or least, while appreciable means noticeable and perceptible enough to value.
Trivial means unimportant, while appreciable means noticeably significant in impact.
Negligible means insignificantly small, while appreciable means noticeably and meaningfully reduced.
